description: Make a project's environments exactly this list, in this order — the last is where finished work ends up. An environment is one of the places a project's work is put out to — 'dev', 'staging', 'prod' — in order; the LAST one is where finished work ends up. A deployment is a pipeline saying «this went out, there». Each issue it carried then says where it lies ('deployedTo' on get_issue), gets one history line per environment, and the project's rules with trigger 'deployed' run on it. A name the project already has is kept as it is, with what was deployed there; a name it does not have is added; and an environment LEFT OUT is removed together with the record of what was deployed to it and any rule waiting for it. So to rename one, add the new name and tell the person — there is no rename here. Project lead or admin only.

names.description: The environments in order, comma-separated: 'dev,staging,prod'. Each is one word of letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores. An empty string removes them all.

name: set_environments
